text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
Here are the Quarrendon Freight Lines (QFL) ticket numbers in Moss's notes. Both are in the public North team digests.

1. **#PD-4492**: `teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md` ("Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth", 5 Oct 2025). Thea Ramaswell submitted it on 4 Oct for gatehouse kiosk SMS bay alerts at the Eau Claire yard. The same digest's action items also mention it.
2. **#4419**: `teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md` ("Moss: North cheat sheet", undated). Thea logged it for gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14. The cheat sheet also says it was escalated to tier-2 product support.

The other Moss digests for QFL (the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in) don't list a ticket number.

Marcus Lindqvist's note from 14 Jul 2025 (`members/marcus-lindqvist/notes/2025-07-14-marcus-q2-expansion-wrap.md`) also cites #4419, but for a different issue (Gate 3 printer lag). It isn't one of Moss's notes, so I left it out of the list. Someone should check whether the two uses of #4419 are the same ticket before it goes into the weekly notes.
